Big Screen Hack: shared imagination

Original conceptual illustration created for Aaron Jones's portfolio with the built-in OpenAI image generation tool. This is illustrative artwork, not a photograph of an event or an image of a particular participant's film.

Visual idea: a shared creative workbench becomes a flowing film ribbon, a cinema screen and an audience. The live portfolio renders the image with its existing persistent blue digit field.

Logo reference: https://www.bigscreenhack.com/assets/logos/bsh-logo.png?v=95ed0244
Event and format reference: https://www.bigscreenhack.com/
Accessed: 10 September 2026.

Big Screen Hack remains the owner of its logo. Festival-week screening references do not imply official Cannes Film Festival selection.
